candidates.title: Compact Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate step using a compact layout with an official adoption badge and pet summary preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off duration (median 89s, mean 1017s) and support emails report custom pet issues. Redesigning adoption screens proved effective (+1.6% avg win) in past tests.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop pet is officially adopted and ready to join your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate while retaining the official seal badge and adoption summary.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesign has solid track record (+1.6% avg across 9 tests). High duration and support reports provide strong evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Status Progress Wait Info
candidates.change: Display explicit progress details and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while desktop render engine initializes.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target) takes median 201s / mean 2336s and past lessons show wait_info changes consistently win (+1.5% avg). Support also reported pets not opening.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet Overlay...
waiting.body: Setting up desktop engine and rendering your pet companion.

guard.reason: Adds real progress and time estimates to the waiting screen without violating fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info is a proven winning category (+1.5% avg). Addresses extremely high wait times and reported bugs.

candidates.title: Pet Persistence & Account Protection Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize protecting pet data and preventing pet loss across restarts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing/reset after signing in. Copy changes on sign_in have the highest win rate (5 out of 11 tests).

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Pet & Save Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely store your pet's memory, items, and settings so your companion is never lost when relaunching.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to explain pet data persistence without introducing dark patterns or pricing info.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+1.6% avg over 11 tests). High evidence from 8 support emails, copy-only implementation.

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Desktop Home Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final home intro screen with a spotlight layout featuring clear interactive control callouts for the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finish step has a low conversion (77.0%) and high mean time (5815s). Support emails show users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now live. Learn the quick desktop controls to interact, move, or hide your pet anytime.

components.text: Click pet to interact | Right-click for menu | Drag to move

candidates.why: Choose path has an extreme mean time (514s) compared to median (8s), indicating user hesitation. Past lessons show redesign changes work well for choose_path (+1.6% avg).

candidates.title: Pet Creation Diagnostic Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Insert a diagnostic recovery sub-flow inside pet upload/creation to automatically detect photo errors and offer quick fixes.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or wrong-looking pets. A diagnostic flow during creation prevents drop-off.

components.text: Ensure good lighting and single-subject focus for best results.

guard.reason: Adds photo diagnostic tools and carousel components inside the photo upload step.

candidates.score_note: New sub-flow has high cost (needs new screens). Past new_flow sample size is small (1 test), leading to lower confidence despite high lift potential.

candidates.title: Account Safeguard & Multi-Device Sync Copy
candidates.change: Add reassurance copy under sign-in options explaining how signing in syncs pet state and prevents account duplication.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-login. Copy changes on sign_in are high-performing.

sign_in.hint: Signing in connects your pet to your account so you can restore your pet anytime on any device.

guard.reason: Adds informative hint copy to the sign-in step without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in copy updates are low cost and high confidence (+1.6% avg), directly addressing 8 user support emails.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Engine Launch Wait Info
candidates.change: Provide detailed notification text and background load progress steps on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s. Giving clear loading status reduces drop-off during long engine load times.

waiting.hint: Loading desktop window renderer... Your pet will pop up on screen in just a moment.

guard.reason: Enhances waiting screen status information while pet overlay is being generated.

candidates.score_note: Wait_info on home step aligns with proven performance (+1.5% avg). Directly targets long engine initialization times.

candidates.title: Late Account Authentication Step Order Adjustment
candidates.change: Move sign-in screen to after pet selection and custom certificate creation so users sign in to save their already created pet.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in after pet adoption creates high motivation to save the pet just created, addressing overall 46.8% conversion.
